anchors.statement: crates/sc-decision-schema must contain only the code necessary to send and receive 100% of the decision API, with nothing beyond that minimum.
anchors.quote: Has the absolute minimum code that is necessary to send/receive 100% of the decision api
anchors.summary: sc-decision-schema holds only minimum decision-API code
anchors.scope: adds or changes code in crates/sc-decision-schema
anchors.deterministic_check: every public item in crates/sc-decision-schema maps to a TypeSafe API request or response field, or to the decision trait

anchors.statement: Every operation available in the sc-ai CLI must also be available in the sc-agent Python API.
anchors.quote: I expect the python api may allow more flexibility than cli, NOT less.
anchors.summary: Python API offers every sc-ai CLI operation
anchors.scope: adds or changes an sc-ai command or the sc-agent Python API
anchors.deterministic_check: each sc-ai subcommand has a matching Python API function, checked by a test that lists both

anchors.statement: No sc-agent REQ, NFR, ADR or bead must cite plan-anchor or judge-jev as the source of a requirement.
anchors.quote: I didn't give you plan-anchor or judge-jev requirements.
anchors.summary: No requirements sourced from plan-anchor or judge-jev
anchors.scope: adds or changes a requirement, type or feature in sc-agent

anchors.statement: sc-agent library code must log through an injected sc-observability logger.
anchors.quote: You need to go through the code and add logging and inject the logger everywhere that should have had it from day-1.
anchors.summary: Library code logs through injected sc-observability logger
anchors.scope: adds or changes code in an sc-agent library crate

anchors.statement: sc-agent must run the Jev requests of one JSONL file, stdio stream or Python call in parallel.
anchors.quote: if I send 1000 jev requests in a single jsonl file/stdio/python call that the calls will be run in parallel w/ a degree of parallelism which has been shown to work.
anchors.summary: One batch of Jev requests runs in parallel
anchors.scope: adds or changes handling of batches of decision requests

history.reason: duplicate of REQ-SAG-0701, which now carries the parallel-batch requirement

anchors.statement: Every sc-agent decision backend must implement the Backend trait defined in the sc-decision-schema crate.
anchors.quote: Every decision backend (Jev, local Jev-compatible runners, Haiku, Luna) implements one sans-IO `Backend` trait in `sc-decision-schema`: encode a Jev API request into an HTTP request, and decode an HTTP response into a Jev API response.
anchors.summary: Every decision backend implements Backend; callers use Decision
anchors.scope: adds or changes a decision backend, the Backend or Decision trait, or sc-decision-runner

anchors.statement: No sc-agent crate's Cargo.toml must depend on a crate in a higher layer, where the layers from the bottom are: types; config, secrets and log; http; decision schema; decision backends; runner.
anchors.quote: Layers from the bottom: `sc-agent-types`; `sc-agent-config`, `sc-agent-secrets` and `sc-agent-log`; `sc-agent-http`; `sc-decision-schema`; the decision backends `sc-decision-systemone`, `sc-decision-local` and `sc-decision-llm` (over `sc-llm-provider`); `sc-decision-runner`, which handles decision models only.
anchors.summary: No crate depends on a crate above it in the layering
anchors.scope: adds or changes a crate dependency in a Cargo.toml

anchors.statement: Every error returned by a public sc-agent function must carry the id and message of each lower-layer error that caused it.
anchors.quote: An error MUST carry the error id and message of every lower-layer error that caused it.
anchors.summary: Each crate returns its own error union carrying lower errors
anchors.scope: adds or changes an error type or a public function's return type

anchors.statement: No type, field or constant in the sc-agent-types or sc-decision-schema crates must be specific to plan-anchor, judge-jev or another application built on sc-agent.
anchors.quote: `sc-agent-types` and `sc-decision-schema` MUST NOT contain types specific to plan-anchor, judge-jev or any other consumer application.
anchors.summary: No consumer-app or Jev-mock types in shared crates
anchors.scope: adds or changes a type in sc-agent-types or sc-decision-schema

anchors.statement: No low-level sc-agent crate (types, config, secrets, log, http, decision schema, decision backends, runner) must depend on tokio with its default features.
anchors.quote: A program that does not use tokio MUST be able to use every low-level crate.
anchors.summary: Low-level crates build and run without tokio
anchors.scope: adds or changes dependencies of a low-level sc-agent crate

anchors.statement: sc-agent source code must not call std::thread::sleep, tokio::time::sleep or any other sleep function.
anchors.quote: sc-agent source code MUST NOT call `std::thread::sleep`, `std::thread::sleep_until`, `tokio::time::sleep` or any other sleep function.
anchors.summary: No sleep calls in sc-agent source
anchors.scope: adds or changes Rust source in an sc-agent crate

anchors.statement: Every Rust type that maps to a field of the TypeSafe Jev API (POST /v1/systemone, GET /v1/models) must be defined in the sc-decision-schema crate.
anchors.quote: Every type that maps to the Jev API MUST be defined in `sc-decision-schema`.
anchors.summary: Jev API types defined only in sc-decision-schema, built from the spec
anchors.scope: adds or changes a type that maps to a TypeSafe API field

anchors.statement: A request that receives an HTTP 429, 502 or 529 response must be resent until a configurable maximum number of sends, 5 by default, is reached.
anchors.quote: A request that receives a busy response MUST be resent unchanged.
anchors.summary: Busy resend: configurable sends, holdoff in the queue
anchors.scope: adds or changes busy-response handling, resend, holdoff or the runner queue

anchors.statement: sc-decision-runner must send the requests of one batch in parallel across a configurable number of worker threads, 8 by default.
anchors.quote: `sc-decision-runner` MUST run the requests of one batch in parallel across workers.
anchors.summary: Batches run in parallel, fastest first, failures returned
anchors.scope: adds or changes batch handling in sc-decision-runner or decide
